questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। EnergyK=Pt=4nJ। ½mv²=1·v²⇒v²=4×(8); force and acceleration constant নয় underconstantpower।

questions.question_bn: Common-emitter switch: emitter grounded, VCC=12 V, RC=1kΩ, β=50, IB=90μA। saturation-এ VCE=0.2 V। active/saturation দুটো অবস্থা বিবেচনা করে collector current কত mA?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Active prediction Ic=βIb=0.5×(9) mA। Load সীমা Ic=(12−0.2)/1000=11.8mA। prediction এই সীমা ছাড়ালে transistor saturated; ছোট মানটি নিতে হবে।

questions.question_bn: H₀=70km/s/Mpc, galaxy distance 7Mpc; local linear approximation। recession speed কত km/s?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Hubble law v≈H₀d for low redshift; multiply 70×(7) with Mpc cancel to km/s।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Soap bubble radius r→2r করতে surface tension T constant। r²T=10 J। work/π কত J?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Bubble two surfaces: U=2T·4πr²=8πTr²। ΔU=8πT(4r²−r²)=24π(10)।

questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। দুই positive সমান component-এর tanθ=vy/vx=1। first quadrant থেকে θ=45°।

questions.question_bn: Speed v=L/t। L=(5±0.01)m,t=(2±0.02)s। first-ordermaxfractionaluncertainty কোনটি?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Fractionaluncertaintyquotient-এ magnitudesadd:δv/v≤δL/L+δt/t=0.01/(5)+0.02/2। sameunitfractions দরকার।

questions.question_bn: Gas density 11 kg/m³, rms speed 30 m/s। pressure কত Pa?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। Kinetic theory P=⅓ρ vrms²=⅓·(11)·900=300×(11)। mean speed ব্যবহার করা যাবে না।

questions.question_bn: Ideal transformer turns Np:Ns=3:1, primary 220 V। secondary current 3A। primary current কত A?

questions.question_bn: Hydrogen-like ion nuclear charge 10। Bohr energy E₁=−1360.0 eV। 2→1 photon energy কত eV?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। En=−13.6Z²/nlevel²। ΔE=13.6Z²(1−¼)=10.2Z²eV; emitted energy positive।

questions.question_bn: Tension factor 25, linear density factor 4 হলে wave speed ratio new/old কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। v=√(T/μ); ratio=√((5)²/4)=(5)/2, square root নিতে হয়।

questions.question_bn: এক car speed 16 m/s থেকে 4 m/s² deceleration-এ থামে। stopping distance কত m?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। v²=u²+2as; final 0, a=−4। s=u²/8=4×(8)²/8=(8)²/2।

questions.question_bn: Convexlensf 4 cm gives real image 2timesobjectsize। object distance কত cm?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Real image|m|=v/u=2⇒v2u।1/f=1/u+1/(2u)=3/(2u)⇒u=1.5f。

questions.question_bn: Sample mass 18g,80%CaCO₃。 excessacidCO₂amount কত mol? MCaCO₃=100
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 18। Pure CaCO₃mass 0.8ng⇒moles 0.8×(18)/100=(18)/125。 carbonateCO₂1:1; impurity inert stated।

questions.question_bn: I₃⁻ molecular geometry কী?

questions.question_bn: Ag Cl Ksp=1×10⁻¹⁰। Na Cl solution [Cl⁻]=13×10⁻²M, Ag Cl saturated; s≪[Cl⁻]। [Ag⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 13। Ksp=[Ag⁺][Cl⁻]। common-ion approximation s=10⁻¹⁰/((13)×10⁻²)=(1/(13))×10⁻⁸M।

questions.question_bn: Bleach sample 12 mol OCl⁻ acidic iodometry-তে I₂ কত mol মুক্ত করে? OCl⁻+2I⁻+2H⁺→I₂+Cl⁻+H₂O
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 12। Balanced reaction অনুযায়ী OCl⁻:I₂=1:1। iodide coefficient 2 হলেও iodine molecules (12) mol; redox electron balance 2।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Equal volumes AgNO₃ ও Na Cl, each 6×10⁻⁴M। Ag Cl Ksp1×10⁻⁸। initial ionic product কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Mixing doubles total volume, each ion concentration (6)×10⁻⁴/2। Qsp=((6)²/4)×10⁻⁸; তারপর Ksp তুলনা করে precipitation।

questions.question_bn: 12 mol monohydric alcohol excess Na-এর সঙ্গে react। H₂ produced কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 12। 2ROH+2Na→2RONa+H₂। alcohol:H₂=2:1; H atom pair করে gas, তাই (12)/2 mol।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 0.1M HCl 14 mL ও 0.1M NaOH 7 mL mix; additive volume। final[H⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Initial H⁺0.2×(7) mmol, OH⁻0.1×(7) mmol; excess 0.1×(7) mmol,total 3×(7) mL। concentration 0.1/3=1/30M।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 4molnon-electrolyte 500gwater-এ dissolve। molality কত mol/kg?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Molality=moles/solventmasskg=(4)/0.5=2×(4)। solution volume বা solution mass denominator নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: A⇌B, initial[A]=12M,[B]=0। equilibrium[B]=1M। Kc কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 12। Stoichiometry 1:1-এ A decreases 1M। equilibrium[A]=(12)−1; Kc=[B]/[A]=1/((12)−1), initial concentration নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: CaCO₃→CaO+CO₂। pure CaCO₃1700g,100%conversion। Ca Oyield কত g? MCaO 56
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 17। CaCO₃moles=(100×(17))/100=(17)। Ca Omoles 1:1×(17),mass 56ng; CO₂44ngsupports massbalance।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: van der Waals gas n=8 mol,b=0.04L/mol,V=8L। available volume V−nb কত L?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। Excluded volume correction nb=0.04nL। available V−nb=(8)−0.04×(8)=0.96nL; attraction term আলাদা।

questions.question_bn: M²⁺+2e⁻→M(s),25°C। ion concentration 10⁻15M। E−E° কত V?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 15। Q=1/[M²⁺]=10ⁿ, solidsactivity 1। Nernstshift−0.0592×(15)/2=−0.0296nV; dilution reduction potential কমায়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Impure CaCO₃sample excessHCl 44mmol reacts। leftoveracid needs NaOH 11mmol। CaCO₃ amount কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। HClconsumed=4×(11)−(11)=3nmmol। CaCO₃+2HCl uses 2acidpercarbonate; CaCO₃=1.5nmmol।

questions.question_bn: Gas volume 25L at300 K,1atm। final 600 K,4atm। final volume কত L?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 25। Fixed gas amount combined law V₂/V₁=(T₂/T₁)(P₁/P₂)=2·¼=½। Celsius ব্যবহার নয়।

questions.question_bn: Ideal gas P2atm,V=86.10000000000001L,T300 K,R0.082। amount কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। (7)=PV/(RT)=2·12.3×(7)/(0.082·300)=24.6×(7)/24.6=(7) mol; no extra Avogadro multiplication।

questions.question_bn: Water Ca²⁺ 31mmol। soap RCOO⁻ stoichiometric precipitate Ca(RCOO)₂ হলে soap anion কত mmol consumed?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 31। Charge-balanced salt requires 2monovalent carboxylate per Ca²⁺। nmmol Ca consumes 2×(31) mmolsoap।

questions.question_bn: Propene+HBr, per oxide absent। major product কী?
questions.explanation: Ionic Markovnikov addition-এ secondary carbocation favoured। Br⁻ middlecarbon-এ attaches; radical per oxide mechanism এখানে absent।

questions.question_bn: A→B ΔH=36kJ/mol; B→C ΔH=−54kJ/mol। A→C ΔH কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 18। Hess law states enthalpy state function। steps add:2×(18)+(−3×(18))=−(18) kJ/mol; route independent।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Ozone decomposition 2O₃→3O₂। 16 mol ozone fully decomposes। total gas mole increase কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 16। FinalO₂=(3/2)(16)। initial gas (16), increase=(3/2)(16)−(16)=(16)/2; final mole ও increment আলাদা।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Chiral carbon-এ SN2 substitution-এর stereochemical outcome কী?
questions.explanation: Backside attack transition state leavinggroup-এর oppositeface-এ nucleophile আসায় Waldeninversion হয়; SN1racemisation অন্য mechanism।

questions.question_bn: l=4 subshell-এ magnetic quantum number mₗ কতটি value নিতে পারে?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। mₗ=−l,…,0,…,+l মোট 2l+1 value। spin multiplicity orbital count-এ multiply করা হয় না।

questions.question_bn: N₂+3H₂→2NH₃। initial N₂=6 mol,H₂=12 mol। maximumNH₃ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। H₂limiting:reactionextent=(2×(6))/3,availableN₂(6) larger। NH₃=2extent=4×(6)/3 mol; balanced coefficients essential।

questions.question_bn: Acidic 2H⁺+2e⁻→H₂। charge 15F,efficiency 100%। hydrogen mole কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 15। TwoelectrononeH₂; n Faradaymeansnmoleelectrons⇒H₂(15)/2 mol。 atom Hcountmoleculecount ভুলনয়।

questions.question_bn: κ=7×10⁻³S/cm,C=0.10 mol/L। Λm কত S·cm²/mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Λm=1000κ/C withcM,κS/cm。1000·(7)10⁻³/0.10=10×(7); L→cm³factor 1000。

questions.question_bn: 19 mol triglyceride complete NaOH saponification-এ NaOH কত mol লাগে?

questions.question_bn: Principal shell n=19। maximum orbital count কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 19। Shell includes l=0…(19)−1। orbital sum Σ(2l+1)=(19)²। electron capacity 2×(19)², orbitals নয়।
